COMMON QUESTIONS

Client Support & Contact FAQs

Everything you need to know about reaching your dedicated Surebound team.

Inquiries submitted through our online secure form during standard business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST) are typically routed and responded to by a licensed insurance underwriter within 15 minutes. Messages received outside standard business hours are answered early the following business morning. For immediate assistance, call us directly at +1 813-214-1731.
Our emergency claims hotline (+1 813-214-1731) is staffed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. Whether you experience a vehicular collision, home pipe burst, severe storm roof damage, or commercial property incident, an emergency claims adjuster is always standing by to dispatch emergency mitigation crews and issue immediate living expense or repair authorizations.
Title companies, mortgage lenders, and escrow officers can send verification requests, mortgagee clause updates, and loss payee change notices directly to support@surebound.com. Include the insured policyholder's full name, property address, and loan number for automated same-day certificate issuance.
Yes. Existing Surebound policyholders can log into our secure User Client Portal to view policies, download auto ID cards, request policy endorsements, add vehicles or drivers, and submit one-time or recurring premium payments.
You are welcome to visit any of our regional hubs in Chicago, New York, Dallas, or Los Angeles during normal business hours. For complex commercial liability audits, high-value asset consultations, or surety bonding lines, we recommend calling +1 813-214-1731 or submitting the contact form with your preferred date and time.
